summary: gyomu-schema provides canonical data models, structural schemas, and validation rules for representing Python AST analysis, structured documents, project knowledge bases, and robust error-handling strategies.
responsibilities: Define canonical data schemas and type models for Python code analysis, structured documentation, and project knowledge.
Provide standardized error definitions, fault-tolerance options, and retry resolution strategies.
Offer helper utilities and validation routines for data serialization, format conversion, and execution monitoring.

capabilities.name: Python AST and Type Models
capabilities.description: Models Python Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) expressions, statements, types, and code structure elements for analysis.

capabilities.name: Structured Document Models
capabilities.description: Defines structured document models, elements, validation rules, and translation strategies.

capabilities.name: Project Knowledge Schemas
capabilities.description: Provides domain-specific schemas for representing project knowledge, guidelines, operational details, and technical references.

capabilities.name: Error Handling and Recovery Schemas
capabilities.description: Defines comprehensive application error hierarchies, retry policies, and resolution strategies across operations.

capabilities.name: Serialization and Utility Framework
capabilities.description: Provides utility functions for serialization, format validation, timing, execution wrapping, and file system operations.

design_decisions: Leverages Pydantic models for robust validation, serialization, and schema definition of complex domain objects.
Organizes schemas hierarchically by domain (Python analysis, documents, knowledge, errors) to maintain clear separation of concerns.
Employs discriminated unions and typed structures to precisely represent heterogeneous AST nodes and document content elements.
usage_guidance: Import specific domain schemas (such as Python AST types, document contents, or knowledge models) from their respective submodules to validate or structure data.
Utilize provided validation and serialization utilities to convert and check data against the defined Pydantic models.
Implement error handling and retry mechanisms using the pre-defined error classes and recovery resolution strategies.
